info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Spine models
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with Spine models

elements.name: spine.play_anim
elements.description: Plays the specified animation on a Spine model. A [ref:spine_animation_done] message is sent to the callback (or message handler). Any spine events will also be handled in the same way. [icon:attention] The callback is not called (or message sent) if the animation is cancelled with [ref:spine.cancel]. The callback is called (or message sent) only for animations that play with the following playback modes * `go.PLAYBACK_ONCE_FORWARD` * `go.PLAYBACK_ONCE_BACKWARD` * `go.PLAYBACK_ONCE_PINGPONG`

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: The Spine model for which to play an animation

parameters.name: anim_id
parameters.doc: Id of the animation to play

parameters.name: playback
parameters.doc: Playback mode of the animation (from go.PLAYBACK_*)

parameters.name: callback_function
parameters.doc: function to call when the animation has completed or a Spine event occurred

elements.name: spine.cancel
elements.description: Cancels all running animations on a specified spine model component

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: The Spine model for which to cancel the animation

elements.name: spine.get_go
elements.description: Returns the id of the game object that corresponds to a specified skeleton bone. Before using this function, make sure the "Create Go Bones" option is enabled in your Spine model.

elements.name: spine.set_skin
elements.description: Sets the spine skin on a spine model.

elements.name: spine.add_skin
elements.description: Adds one spine skin on a spine model to another on the same model.

parameters.name: skin_a
parameters.doc: Id of the corresponding skin that will recieve the added skin

parameters.name: skin_b
parameters.doc: Id of the corresponding skin to add

elements.name: spine.copy_skin
elements.description: Copies one spine skin on a spine model to another on the same model.

parameters.name: skin_a
parameters.doc: Id of the corresponding skin that will recieve the copied skin

parameters.name: skin_b
parameters.doc: Id of the corresponding skin to copy.

elements.name: spine.clear_skin
elements.description: Clear all attachments and constraints from a skin on a spine model

elements.name: spine.set_attachment
elements.description: Set the attachment of a slot on a spine model.

parameters.name: attachment
parameters.doc: Id of the attachment. May be nil to reset to default attachment.

elements.name: spine.set_slot_color
elements.description: Set the color a slot will tint its attachments on a spine model.

parameters.name: color
parameters.doc: Tint applied to attachments in a slot

elements.name: spine.reset_constant
elements.description: Resets a shader constant for a spine model component. (Previously set with `go.set()`)

elements.name: spine.reset_ik_target
elements.description: reset the IK constraint target position to default of a spinemodel.

parameters.name: ik_constraint_id
parameters.doc: id of the corresponding IK constraint

elements.name: spine.set_ik_target_position
elements.description: set the target position of an IK constraint object.

parameters.name: ik_constraint_id
parameters.doc: id of the corresponding IK constraint

elements.name: spine.set_ik_target
elements.description: set the IK constraint object target position to follow position.

parameters.name: ik_constraint_id
parameters.doc: id of the corresponding IK constraint

elements.name: spine.physics_translate
elements.description: Apply a physics-based translation to the Spine model.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: The Spine model component to translate.

parameters.name: translation
parameters.doc: The translation vector to apply to the Spine model.

elements.name: spine.physics_rotate
elements.description: Apply a physics-based rotation to the Spine model.

parameters.name: url
parameters.doc: The Spine model component to rotate.

parameters.name: center
parameters.doc: The center point around which to rotate.
